name: claude-jev
description: Ask TypeSafe's Jev model for calibrated judgements during code review, investigation and planning.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Pin a version to keep thresholds stable across releases.

allowSourceReading.title: Let the server read source files
allowSourceReading.description: When off, only text passed in the tool call is sent to TypeSafe.

maxFileBytes.title: Maximum bytes per source
maxFileBytes.description: Longer snippets are truncated before they are sent.

maxFilesPerCall.title: Maximum sources per call
maxFilesPerCall.description: Upper bound on files read for one tool call.

maxRequests.title: Maximum requests per call
maxRequests.description: Ceiling on the fan-out when questions do not fit beside the state in one request.
